packageRules.description: The Kubernetes client libraries are held to the minor that supports the server versions in the CI matrix. client-go follows the ±1 skew policy, so v0.35.x covers 1.34 through 1.36. Moving the minor is a decision about which clusters this tool supports, not a routine bump: it must go with a matrix change in .github/workflows/integration.yml.
Charm libraries move together; a split update leaves bubbletea and bubbles on incompatible versions.
Action digests are pinned, so the tag comment is what identifies them. Grouped to keep the noise down.
The k3s versions in the integration matrix define which servers are tested. They are bound to the client-go minor above and must not drift independently.

customManagers.description: Versions pinned in shell scripts and Makefiles, marked with a renovate comment on the preceding line.
